title: Care Plan Status and the Remaining-Units Deduction on Prior Authorization Extensions
content:
When a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension is recorded, the deduction of the units remaining on the authorization follows the member's Care Management care plan and the units remaining.

## Rule

1. Where a care plan update was recorded in the month before the day of the extension and the units remaining are no more than the class's weekly frequency cap, **nothing is deducted**.
2. Where such a care plan update was recorded and the units remaining exceed the weekly frequency cap, only the units the weekly frequency cap cannot deliver before the current end date are deducted: the units remaining less the weekly frequency cap multiplied by the whole weeks from the day of the extension to the current end date, never below zero. The whole weeks are the days from the day of the extension to the current end date divided by seven and rounded down.
3. Otherwise — no care plan update recorded in the month before the day of the extension — **all of the units remaining are deducted**.

The care plan update is one recorded by the member's Care Management care team. The deduction is subtracted once, before the floor of zero and the ceiling of the class's extension allotment are applied.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical class with a weekly frequency cap of 3 units)

| Care plan update in the month | Units remaining | Days to the current end date | Deduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| recorded | 3 | 10 | 0 (no more than the cap) |
| recorded | 5 | 10 | one whole week; 5 less 3 is 2 |
| recorded | 5 | 21 | three whole weeks; 5 less 9 falls below zero, so 0 |
| recorded | 8 | 13 | one whole week; 8 less 3 is 5 |
| not recorded | 5 | 10 | 5 |
